steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Yes, it's me! I just came back from our Diet friend's place!

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Where is Hoshiguma?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: The venue?!

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: What about Mio? Has she dealt with them?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: No?! She left?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: That traitor!

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: What about the network? Did you record what's going on inside? What about Hoshiguma?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Dammit! Get the editors on it NOW and make the footage of her fight with Mio look like she's completely lost control—

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: What do you mean there's no time?! Hacking? Hijacked network?! Can't deal with it?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: What good are you?! Cut the signal if you can't deal with it! The power supply too! The only thing left to air tonight is the apology! Who cares if the signal goes out?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: We can't have someone babbling on MY channel—

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Hello? Hello?!

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Chikusho! Lost the signal?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: You idiot! You demand I come and give a personal explanation, that just gives my enemies a chance to strike!

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Everything's gone to hell while I was humoring that bastard... even Hannya is gone...

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: (Takes a deep breath)

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Calm down.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Clean up the mess and start over. It'll be alright. It's not the first time.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: First, go to the venue and stop those insects. The diet has given the nod on Hoshiguma. All that's left is to clean up public opinion...

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Came to cause trouble with your dear Hoshiguma-aneki, have you?

spans.text: Came to cause trouble with your dear Hoshiguma

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Hoshiguma?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Oh my goodness. Should I compliment you for your bravery, or your adorable stupidity?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Look at how beat-up you are. Seems like my men were still playing with you, not knowing that you no longer had any use.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Who did you grab this real sword from? Tell me, and I'll return it to him before he gets angry.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Kinbee... you...

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I don't have time to play with you, Tetsuya.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Your father may have taught you the basics of swordsmanship when you were little, but you have a long, long way to go before you're ready to use it in a real fight.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: A father and son who got turned against each other by a mask. How much do you think you actually understood about the swordplay that he taught you?

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Turned against?!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Yes... turned against each other...

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I've said all I needed to say. Now get lost before I change my mind and reunite you with Tessai.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: You're the one who should be reunited with my father!

a.text: I know. Countless people are watching me. I must tell them the truth.
They love Momoka Hanyuu. They love to watch her panic at all the kaidan that seem to orbit around her.
They love to watch me get scared, not speak the truth, and certainly not the real me...
Yes, I'm afraid of even that.
Being afraid is the biggest common denominator between Haruka Shino and Momoka Hanyuu.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Hello everyone, good... good evening.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I... I'm Momoka Hanyuu... the girl who's so afraid of kaidan, but who just couldn't seem to get away from them.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'm sorry for disturbing you all, after that big accident that just occurred on air...

steps.name: Surprised Fan
steps.text: Momo-cchi?!

steps.name: Confused Fan
steps.text: Didn't she go missing? How did she suddenly pop up like that?

steps.name: Surprised Fan
steps.text: Was that emergency broadcast really a kaidan?

steps.name: Confused Fan
steps.text: Is she caught in the middle of a kaidan... and looking for help from us?!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: As you can see, I'm standing here before you.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Strange things seem to happen to me all the time. That's how kaidan are: they appear without warning, and disappear the same way.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: But what if I told you that all the kaidan were fake, from the very beginning?

steps.name: Sarcastic Passerby
steps.text: Momoka? Kinseki Channel's really throwing money into her, pulling that disappearing act. What's the kaidan this time?

steps.name: Roaming Passerby
steps.text: She said they're fake.

steps.name: Sarcastic Passerby
steps.text: What? Is she out of her mind? Does she think we're all stupid? Aren't kaidan all around us all the time?

steps.name: Roaming Passerby
steps.text: That's what she said. Don't ask me, watch her yourself.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: What if I told you that, with the exception of a handful of kaidan associated with the kami, all the shows that I've been on, all the kaidan that I experienced... all of them were fabricated?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'm not talking about hypotheticals. I'm talking about true lies.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Kinseki Station and the Kinseki Talent Agency deceived you, and I unknowingly became their accomplice.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I won't make any excuses for deceiving you. I'll accept any criticism.

steps.name: Angry Mother
steps.text: I told you, no TV tonight!

steps.name: Excited Child
steps.text: My classmate told me they're airing something really amazing! Look! The kaidan lady spills the beans on fake kaidan!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I've been a part... of countless lies.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: For example, the original kaidan, the family home of the Ao-Oni of the Kinsekikai in Kajimachi that killed its residents.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: It was no paranormal activity, just actual murder.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I now accuse Kouhei Mifune, president of Kinseki Channel and the Kinseki Talent Agency, and the de facto leader of the Kinsekikai yakuza syndicate, of being the mastermind behind all this.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Without any evidence, he suspected me of being in league with his political opponent, Tessai, and plotted to infect me with Oripathy, when I knew nothing of any of it.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: The 'Ao-Oni of Kinsekikai' was exiled from Mitsukue after taking the fall for his crimes, many years ago. She was framed for my kidnapping, when in fact, she had saved my life.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: When I accidentally stumbled upon the truth behind the kaidan, he wanted to silence me, spreading rumors that I was retiring...

steps.name: Officer on Patrol
steps.text: Detective Koretou! Upstairs is absolutely fuming!

steps.name: Officer on Patrol
steps.text: This is the eighth time they're ordering us to cut the signal...

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: What did we do with the last seven orders?

steps.name: Officer on Patrol
steps.text: ...Nothing.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: You've got it.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: I know you've been unhappy about me saying that things will get better. I stopped believing it myself at some point.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Whatever happens tonight is on me. Let there be one night when the police don't have to grovel to anyone. It's my parting gift to you.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: ...This is what I needed to tell you tonight.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Next, there's something else I want to tell you... about myself.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I know a lot of people think I'm overacting in the shows... you think I'm being dramatic on purpose.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: What I want to tell you is that fear has been a constant in Momoka Hanyuu's entire life.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Partly, it's because I was told too many horror stories when I was little, but...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: The more important reason is that I grew up in Gokawa, the city infamous for its polluted water.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: There, fear is not about serial killers roaming the streets at night, unicycles that bring misfortune, or elevators to hell...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: It is about watching your loved ones becoming bedridden all of a sudden, falling while walking on flat ground, and losing the feeling in their hands.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: It all happens so naturally, so gradually... and it's too late by the time you realize it.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I was one of the lucky ones. I came to Mitsukue, to be bathed in people's attention, be it adoring, judging, or scornful.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: My fear was no longer about pain, illness and death; it was about viewer ratings, losing fans, pressure from the agency, and fabricated kaidan.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: It seems such a luxury to fear those things, now that my life is once again under threat.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Isn't it a sort of happiness, to be afraid of kaidan?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: We don't need to face true danger. We lie in our beds, screaming at stories we don't know if they're true, and satisfy ourselves with the sensation of our nerves tightening and relaxing again.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: But... I'm afraid I can never enjoy it the same way again.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: This luxury was lost to me forever when I learned that the kaidan that used to scare me were lies, manifestations of greed, murders, and cover-ups.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: From this day forth, kaidan shall no longer be part of Momoka Hanyuu's life.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I hereby announce that I am leaving the Kinseki Talent Agency, and disassociating myself from all Kinsekikai affiliates!
Tetsuya is lying on the ground next to Mifune, wounded but alive.
It is not that the Phidia intended to spare him.

Indeed, Mifune wanted to put an end to this quickly many times, only to be forced back by the suicidal attacks of the young Oni, who seemed to be intentionally aiming himself at the tip of Mifune's sword, just to find a chance to take Mifune down with him.
Momoka's speech coming through the screen beside him only served as a further distraction, and his trembling hands repeatedly missed their mark.

Even as Mifune changed his goal from killing to incapacitation, and then to simply shaking off this maniac in order to deal with the fallout, Tetsuya kept getting up from the ground, in spite of all his injuries.
Meanwhile, Momoka's speech is drawing to a close.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I will continue to walk the performer's path, as long as I live.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I want to bring hope to others, and tell those plagued by fear that there is someone who was once just like you, someone who knows how you feel.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: She will sing your story, act your story. She will do all that she can, so that your voices will not fade into darkness.
Momoka wipes away a drop of sweat from her brow.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Wow, I really said a lot, didn't I?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: You know, I'm starting to get cold feet now, after having said all that. I'm really timid, after all.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Maybe the kaidan aren't the only lies in our lives. Maybe there are countless more lies like theirs, and the prosperity that we enjoy...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: ...is built upon these lies.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: What is that bitch babbling about?!

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: She doesn't know that everything is built upon faith. She doesn't know that if panic spreads—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: But... this is our life. And it will continue, until the end arrives... if it arrives.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Even if it is built upon lies... upon bubbles that might shatter tomorrow, it's still our life...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: A life that I have to learn to love.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Besides, even if a life like this is destined to disappear someday... it's beautiful, isn't it?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: An instant of beauty will be the warmth that stays with us through the cold night, even after everything else falls apart... as long as we keep it in our hearts.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: That's all I want to say.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: This has been Momoka Hanyuu, and I apologize for taking up your valuable time.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Perhaps... no, we WILL meet again.
There is no longer any possibility of turning the tables.
The Phidia stares blankly at the figure on the screen.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Oh, you got up again.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Shall we continue?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: The bitch is done babbling. You can try to take revenge for your pop now, again.
The young Oni sets his unsteady feet. The Phidia has collected himself, and identifies an opening that will let him put his sword right through the ribs of the Oni when he makes his move.
But the Oni does not move.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Are you scared?

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: But even a fool like me can tell that you're finished.
Tetsuya turns around. Mifune's face is ghastly pale, but he does not make a move.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: I'm showing my back to you. Aren't you going to kill me?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Not in the mood. There are plenty of other people I want to kill first.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I'll come find you when they're all dead.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Oh, and one more thing...
Mifune stares at Tetsuya's back. Suddenly, he blurts out a sentence that even he himself is unsure why he says it.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: The words that I said to your father... They were actually for you.
Tetsuya cannot tell if these words are meant to provoke, or to accomplish something else. He turns and casts one glare at Mifune with bloodshot eyes, before leaving with unsteady steps.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Phew...
Everything feels so surreal, like a dream.
After finishing her speech, she fainted onstage out of excitement.
Everything that happened next was like a blur... in any case, Hoshiguma went upstairs, while Moriuchi, Kichisei, and Sarasa took her downstairs.
She seems to remember fighting and explosions, but it all felt so far away—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Where are we? Kichisei? Moriuchi-san? Sarasa?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Why is Sarasa on the ground... she's asleep?!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: She fell asleep in the TV station too... does she get tired easy?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: No time for this—it's my turn to carry her now!

steps.name: Kichisei's Voice
steps.text: Where are you, Momoka? Where's Sarasa?

steps.name: Kichisei's Voice
steps.text: Did you get lost in the alleys?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'm—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Mmph!

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Gotcha!

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: I... I got her! On my own! I-I might get promoted for this...

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Good thing I had duct tape on me. She's a singer, who knows how loud she can get when she hollers?

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: I dreamed about 'ninjutsu items' before I became a ninja, but it's only the veterans who get to use the good stuff, while all I have is trash...

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Gotta report this upstairs—

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Gah, I forgot I discharged my terminal so I could enjoy an afternoon of peace and quiet in one of the coffee shops in the alleys.

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Then this girl just falls into my hands like that! It's definitely my lucky day.

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Where's my Originium Circuit Hyourougan?
The ninja takes out the Originium Circuit Hyourougan, a spherical Originium appliance with a long wire attached to it, which he connects to the depleted terminal.

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: It's charging so slowly.

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Hey, how about I pull that tape off your mouth, and you sing a song or two for me?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Mmph, mm, mmmh!

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Well, it's not like I would do it, even if you nodded.

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Did you know? We were looking for you everywhere after you ran away on that motorbike that night. I was the one who searched your house.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Mmh!

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Boy, was that a crappy place. Big idol like you, I thought you'd be living in a mansion or something, but you didn't have anything worth shit.

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: What's with the collection of garbage by your window, anyway? Some kind of weird obsession?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Mmph—argh! *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Say that again?!

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: The tape came loose? I thought I put it on right.

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Hmph, who cares, just a frail little idol.

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: I tell you, not only did I have to check all that weird garbage you had by the window one by one, I also trimmed that dying plant for you.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: You cut Hasuke?!

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: 'Hasuke'? Oh, that tree sprout was barely even a weed.

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Yeah, I did it. What about it? How did you even take care of it? I have no idea, 'cause its leaves were all yellow and brittle. No way it was gonna live, so I put it out of its misery. It was a kindness.

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: I've grown flowers before, and it takes patience, and endless love and care, you understand? Someone like you—

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Hey, hey, hey, how did you get up? What kind of crappy duct tape was that?

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: I see, you must know some sort of Arts... you're Ægir, so I guess it's about water? That's it, of course, no wonder the tape came loose.

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: But didn't the vets say that only the Infected could use Arts without a unit? That's weird. You couldn't have broken the tape with brute force, could you?

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Nah, of course not. I doubt you've ever lifted anything heavier than an apple! Must be Arts, definitely.

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: So what? What are you gonna do, spray water in my face?
The novice ninja taunts Momoka, but he keeps his gaze fixed on her eyes.
A cornered beast will fight back, and the same is true for the girl in front of him. What kind of Arts will she use? Mist? A high-pressure jet? Acid spray, even?
He must not let his guard down just because he is facing an idol with no combat experience.
It is unlikely that her Arts would be particularly powerful, and there would be little movement from her microphone-shaped Arts unit when she casts. Better to stay focused on her eyes.
Her eyes will betray all that she is thinking.
For example... murderous intent.
Foolish girl, not knowing her place.
But that is all. Observe her eyes, and analyze her intent, be it the timing of casting, direction, or...
Why is there no intent other than murder?
Before he can react, the ninja feels a dull 'thud' on his head.

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Wha-you hit me on the head with your mic? What kind of Arts is...?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: MURDERER!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: BEAST!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: HEARTLESS DEVIL!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: THIS IS FOR HASUKE!

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: W-Wait, calm down—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: NO I WILL NOT!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: IT WASN'T DEAD YET! HOW COULD YOU—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: HOW COULD YOU CUT MY HASUKE?!
Momoka babbles her incoherent vengeful fury, a far cry from the image that she presented on stage just moments ago.
Her microphone finds the ninja, again and again, striking with a fury that even hell does not know...

steps.name: Novice Ninja
steps.text: Stop, stop, no—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I WILL KILL YOU, YOU BASTARD! I WILL BEAT THIS HEARTLESS MONSTER TO DEATH!!!

steps.name: Stunned Voice
steps.text: Momoka?! What are you doing?

steps.name: Furious Voice
steps.text: I'M KILLING THE BASTARD WHO KILLED MY HASUKE! I WILL RIP HIM FROM LIMB TO LIMB!!!

steps.name: Stunned Voice
steps.text: So, you're, er... you're fine?

steps.name: Furious Voice
steps.text: I'M FINE! I'M VERY FINE! I'M GONNA BEAT THIS ASSHOLE INTO A PULP!!!

steps.name: Stunned Voice
steps.text: M-Momoka, calm down, he's not worth it, we gotta get out of here...
The rain of blows finally comes to an end, as footsteps fade into the distance.
That other voice must have belonged to Kichisei, the one who was with Momoka. Yes, it was Kichisei who took Momoka away, it must be her...
Thank you, Kichisei... you're my lucky star—
The novice ninja gives Kichisei his most sincere gratitude before passing out. Not that he is in any condition to verbalize it.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I've been waiting for you. No one can stop you, even after all these years.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Quit posturing. Your men have already scattered. I strolled right on in here.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: What business does the 'Ao-Oni of Kinsekikai' have with a man who's already finished?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: If you came to take revenge for yourself and Tessai, all you need to do is draw your sword.
Hoshiguma shakes her head.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Your crimes have been exposed on your own TV station. Your Diet member upstairs won't help you now, no matter how much bribe money he got from you.

spans.text: Your crimes have been exposed on your own TV station. Your Diet member
won't help you now, no matter how much bribe money he got from you.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: How he may try to cover up his ill-gotten gains is none of my business.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's enough for me that justice will be served for the people you actually killed.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: You almost sound like a cop.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Yeah, I've been working for the Lungmen police force.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: ...Are you serious?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Yes, I am.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I want to laugh, but I'm not quite in the mood tonight. And I thought the L.G.D. was just a gimmick.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I only came to do what I should have done when I took that step twenty years ago. I came to cut my last ties to Higashi.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: And how do you intend to do that? You can't cut yourself off from your past. Karma and fate will always follow you.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: You could put them in chains, lock them in boxes, but they will escape when you're least prepared, and tear everything into pieces.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: The only thing you can cut is my throat, and it would be nothing more than a formality if you did so. Nothing more than venting your anger.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Yeah, a formality.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: There's nothing I want from you or Mitsukue. All I want is a formality.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: A letter of excommunication. Tell all of Mitsukue that Hoshiguma no longer has anything to do with Mitsukue, the Kinsekikai, or the Ao-Oni kaidan.
The tall Phidia blinks, then begins laughing wryly.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I see Lungmen has indeed turned you into a cop, through and through.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: But I refuse. We have a better way of disassociating someone.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Cross swords with me. Rebel against the oyabun of the Kinsekikai, and there will be no room left for the Kinsekikai to treat you as one of us, no matter which one of us falls.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Do we really have to do this?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: This is the true meaning of finishing unfinished business from twenty years ago.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: It's just...
Mifune casts a glance around his office.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I rather liked this place, and it would be a shame if a mess was made of it. Let's go somewhere else.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Where?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Kajimachi.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You've razed it to the ground.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Our memories remain, don't they?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're one twisted bastard.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Let's go. Maybe we'll even catch the end of the fireworks show.
